column4: Do you know what your problem is Max? You make resolutions but you never stick to them.

column4: You could get done for breach of contract if you don't stick to its terms and conditions.

column4: Don't fall for his charms; he'll only lead you astray.

column4: After he took my money and fled, I knew I'd been led astray.
